_comment: The single source of truth for what fits on the MOOKS panel. Consumed by the CI validator AND by the Swift simulator. If you change a limit here, re-render the simulator before you believe it.

display.note: Limits below are measured against a FIXED-WIDTH 5x7 font. On device the firmware uses proportional u8g2 faces (helvB14_tr / helvR08_tr), which can only ever give more room. A font change must never be able to break a layout.

drop.note: Exactly five. Not four, not twenty. Finiteness is the product, so it is enforced by the build, not by editorial discipline.

link.note: Short codes keep the QR at version 1-2 (21-25 modules). At 2px per module that is 42-50px on a 128px panel. Longer payloads push the modules below 2px and phones stop reading them.

trend.note: A numeric trend must carry a source. If you cannot cite it, use a direction word. Printing invented precision on a physical object is the fastest way to lose a reviewer's trust (review risk 13).
